An absent founder is explicitly recorded and contributes zero by definition, not a missing scientific loss. Unknown flags, missing years or changed bindings do not receive substituted values. This is saved native activity, not continuous survival/person-time, actual useful research work, resource sufficiency, scientific truth or an adoption veto.
